---------------

A Leave request is awaiting approval with the following details


Details of the Leave:



Employee Name: <%leaveSeekerName%>


Leave Duration: <%startDate%> to <%endDate%>


Total Days: <%numberOfDays%>


Reason for Leave:<%description%>

Should there be any emergencies or if further clarification is needed, I can be reached at <%contactPhone%>.


<%assistLogo%>
Assist Leave Notification.
